signature_info.description: Initializes Appid ManagedInstaller and Smartscreen Telemetry

attributes.magic: PE32 executable (console) Intel 80386, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: This binary is a specialized management utility designed to manipulate the Windows AppLocker Filter Driver (applockerfltr). It provides command-line arguments to start or stop the service and modify the system configuration via the registry. Key behaviors include modifying the registry key 'HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\AppID\Configuration\SMARTLOCKER' using RegSetValueExW and interacting with the Service Control Manager (SCM) to reconfigure or stop the 'applockerfltr' driver via ChangeServiceConfigW and ControlService. While potentially used for legitimate administration, these capabilities are primarily associated with defense evasion, as disabling the AppLocker filter bypasses application whitelisting policies.
